description:
Position: Java Developer 
 Location: Atlanta GA 
 
 Duration: 2 Months c2h 
 Qualifications 
 Strong Experience with Java, Spring MVC, Hibernate, JPA, Spring, HTML, CSS, and Relational databases. Excellent communication is a MUST. 
 
 • 2+ years Application Development experience which includes the programming/ development of web applications 

 • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent. 

 • Successful track record in designing and implementing web applications using Java, Spring, Spring MVC, Hibernate, JPA, Maven, rules engines. 

 • Experience integrating applications and designing and developing web services and frameworks. Extensive front and back end experience required. 

 • Outstanding oral and written communication skills and experience working directly with end users to understand and translate requirements to design. 

 • Demonstrated ability to evaluate new and emerging technologies and vendor products and to constructively apply them to meet identified business and technology goals. 

 • Ability to work in a team environment 

 • Demonstrated ability to think strategically and realize those strategies in application design. 

 • Strong ability to diagnose critical problems and develop solutions. 

 • Ability to take part in production support and lead troubleshooting calls as needed. 

 • Strong understanding and experience with SQL/Stored Procedure.

 • Strong understanding and experience with test-driven development.

 • Strong understanding of Java, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

 • Relational databases - preferably SQL Server 2008.

 
 
 
 

 Client is looking for US Citizens & GC. 

 Syed Mohammad Asif 
 408-775-7468
